name: Jake Macqueen
bio:
Jake Macqueen is a master in the realm of black and grey tattoos, showcasing an exceptional skill level that dazzles the skin with monochromatic artistry. His workspace at Collingwood Tattoo Company in Collingwood, Canada, is a testament to his dedication to maintaining a clean and hygienic environment, ensuring that every client enjoys a safe and sanitary tattooing experience. Jake's impeccable cleanliness has earned him a reputation as a tattoo artist who not only excels in his craft but also prioritizes the well-being of his clients.

Current location: Collingwood, Ontario, Canada
